purpose: Validate and expose only an already-authored, explicitly Public CGX/FileSpace derived projection through the existing LS GO visitor adapter.

architecture.canonical_identity: CGX = FileSpace; this contract is a derived view adapter and never a second object store, resolver authority, DBR root, runtime or scheduler.
architecture.runtime_binding: Existing LS GO FastAPI visitor adapter only.

manifest.runtime_source: Owner-configured local manifest reference; path is not returned to visitors and manifest is not copied into dist-review.

proof_rules: projection_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON payload (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8)
source_sha256 and any model/citation SHA-256 are exact 64-hex content identities
object_id and lens must exactly match the visitor request
model URL, when present, is pre-approved HTTPS metadata only; LS GO does not fetch or transform it
release receipt is necessary but does not transfer source/canonical authority
unknown or malformed fields fail closed rather than being stripped and served
forbidden_public_material: credentials, keys, tokens or override mechanics

visitor_result.answer_semantics: pre-approved projection summary only; never represented as model-generated AI output
visitor_result.model_semantics: pre-approved model metadata only when exact hash + HTTPS URL exist
